meta_data.base_class: Return the result of a specific match in a <team-based competitive sport> - refers to a sport where structured matches are held between two teams within a formal league or tournament season.

tool_template.name: match_results_<class>
tool_template.description: Returns the results of a given <class> match between two teams.

team1.description: The name of the first team in the <class> match.

team2.description: The name of the second team in the <class> match.

season.description: The season when the <class> match happened.

location.description: The venue where the <class> match was held.

tournament_name.description: The name of the league in which the <class> match was a part.

home_away.description: Flag to indicate whether the match was played at the home or away venue of the first listed team, one of 'home' or 'away'.
